title: MRAG: Multi-hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Graph Connectivity
tldr: MRAG uses graph connectivity to improve multi-hop retrieval in GraphRAG systems
main_contribution: Novel spectral graph-based re-ranking method for retrieval
problem_statement: Existing GraphRAG methods ignore graph structure, leading to fragmentation and retrieval failure
method_intuition: Leverages spectral graph theory to analyze graph connectivity and identify fragmentation patterns
design_rationale: Balances accuracy and efficiency by trading some speed for significant accuracy gains
tradeoffs: Requires additional graph preprocessing time and higher memory for large graphs
rough_limitation: Does not consider dynamically updating knowledge graphs

title: GraphRAG: Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Complex Queries
tldr: End-to-end GraphRAG system using community detection for retrieval
main_contribution: Community-based retrieval method with global query focus
problem_statement: Traditional RAG fails on complex multi-hop queries requiring structured knowledge
method_intuition: Builds knowledge graph from documents and uses community detection for hierarchical retrieval
design_rationale: Global search over communities captures broader context than local retrieval
tradeoffs: Higher preprocessing cost but better multi-hop performance
rough_limitation: Static graph construction doesn't handle streaming updates

title: Dynamic Graph Construction for Streaming RAG
tldr: Streaming graph updates for real-time RAG applications
main_contribution: Incremental graph update algorithm with low latency
problem_statement: Static graphs cannot handle rapidly evolving knowledge bases
method_intuition: Uses delta-encoding for efficient graph mutations
design_rationale: Prioritizes update speed over query optimization
tradeoffs: Query performance slightly degraded for update efficiency
rough_limitation: Limited to entity-centric updates, not relationship changes
